analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch adds a clarification at head lines 2966-2970: the cluster control leader re-plans and re-adopts a model only once both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and the pair's coordinated update restarts the two Macs seconds apart. The supplied units are head-text excerpts at lines 2026-2840, which surround but do not include the changed hunk. I examined them for security-relevant documentation content: MTP acceptance, sampling defaults, constrained JSON, tool-call parsing, the MiMo native path, and prefix-cache and SSD references. The visible text is unchanged context. It describes no new endpoints, trust boundaries, key handling, attestation, authorization, or cache storage behavior, and it weakens no mitigation. I checked the context against the retained T-041 prefix-cache threat (cross-tenant TTFT oracle, HMAC-keyed SSD tier, 30-minute TTL). The visible lines still say that cache identity and security checks apply and that the sampler is not part of cache identity. Nothing there widens at-rest exposure. The cluster update statement is documentation of a coordination timing constraint and changes no code. The cluster re-plan and coordinated-update path (ClusterService.checkForUpdate, ClusterOnboardingUpdate) is outside the supplied evidence, as are the referenced cluster-always-on.md and any cluster trust boundary. I therefore make no claim about that behavior's security properties, such as peer build verification or availability under a mismatched build. No concrete regression is identified, and the threat model needs no update from this docs-only change.
